g.title: PSU_L
g.text: 5 V 3 A, logic only (Pico, DFPlayer, level shifter)

g.title: TB_5V
g.text: 1 from PSU_L, 2 to D1, 3 to DFPlayer, 4 to U1 HV

g.title: TB_GND
g.text: The one point where every ground meets: logic supply, Pico, DFPlayer, U1, both rigs, amp

g.title: W_DATA_A
g.text: Rig A data and ground pair, twisted
2.7 m is the maximum from U1 to pixel 1 (about 3 m unbuffered, less 10%)

g.title: W_DATA_B
g.text: Rig B data and ground pair, twisted
2.7 m is the maximum from U1 to pixel 1 (about 3 m unbuffered, less 10%)

g.title: D1
g.text: Soldered at the Pico's VSYS pin. With USB also plugged in, the higher of USB and the logic rail powers the Pico and neither feeds the other (Pico 2 datasheet, Powering Pico)

g.title: PICO
g.text: Physical pin numbers. GP4 is UART1 TX to the DFPlayer; GP5 (UART1 RX) is reserved and left unwired. 3V3 sets the level shifter's low side. VBUS stays unwired so the logic rail never back-feeds a laptop's USB port

g.title: DFP
g.text: Line output from DAC_L/DAC_R feeds the amp. SPK_1/SPK_2 is the built-in 3 W speaker driver and stays unwired. TX stays unwired: commands are sent without feedback

g.title: U1
g.text: BSS138 4-channel MOSFET board, 3.3 V to 5 V

The board prints labels, not numbers: 1-6 are the LV row and 7-12 the HV row, left to right (pin guide: level-shifter.jpg). Each channel's high side rises only through the board's 10 kohm pull-up, too slowly for 2.7 m of cable, so R_PU_A and R_PU_B add 1.5 kohm to HV. Channels 3 and 4 stay unwired; the board pulls them up

g.title: R_PU_A
g.text: 1.5 kohm 1/4 W, HV1 pull-up to HV

Across the board's HV1 and HV pins, soldered or in free breadboard holes. In parallel with the board's 10 kohm, it sharpens the rising edge over 2.7 m; the Pico sinks about 3.6 mA through it when the line is low

g.title: R_PU_B
g.text: 1.5 kohm 1/4 W, HV2 pull-up to HV
Across the board's HV2 and HV pins, as R_PU_A

g.title: R_A
g.text: 330 ohm 1/4 W, series, rig A data
Soldered at rig A's DIN pad, damping reflections on the long run

g.title: STRIP_A
g.text: Pins 1-3 at pixel 1, pins 4-5 at pixel 151. Cut +5V only between pixels 150 and 151

g.title: R_B
g.text: 330 ohm 1/4 W, series, rig B data
Soldered at rig B's DIN pad, damping reflections on the long run

g.title: STRIP_B
g.text: Pins 1-3 at pixel 1, pins 4-5 at pixel 151. Cut +5V only between pixels 150 and 151

g.title: PSU_AMP
g.text: By the central enclosure; kept off the 5 V rails because the amp switches noisily

g.title: AMP
g.text: Confirm the input terminals against the board's silkscreen before wiring

g.title: W_SPK
g.text: Planning length; the speaker sits by the central enclosure

g.title: R_SUM_L
g.text: 10 kohm 1/4 W, sums DAC_L into the mono input
Soldered at the amp's IN+ terminal

g.title: R_SUM_R
g.text: 10 kohm 1/4 W, sums DAC_R into the mono input
Soldered at the amp's IN+ terminal. The pair mixes both channels without shorting DAC_L to DAC_R; wiring DAC_L to IN+ and DAC_R to IN- would cancel the thunder
